description: 🩷主に1枚絵のリクエストを受け付けています！！！🩵ポップな塗りと豊かな表情が得意です！！！💚カワイイ女の子からセクシーなお姉さん、男の子も描けます！！キャラデザ、衣装デザインも！！⚠️版権ものの二次創作のご依頼はNG⚠️(🧡本体はこちら ▶ @100hituzi💜)

works.body: hello!! lovely to work with you again!! i would like to request my trainer / producer sona design in the race outfit of the umamusume mihono bourbon!! she is one of my favorite umas and i thought this would be fun!! my character is tall and goofy and excited! i compared them last time to kirari moroboshi in energy! you did a wonderful job capturing me and it made me so happy 🥹🫶 so i would like to be silly and happy in her outfit! i have a flat chest as a reminder!! here is my ref folder! thank you for the consideration and have a nice christmas! https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1puhi1lyIvufBfmEYyIfk9d-mUOdqWCL_
